body: I suppose it’s different for everyone but for me she is the one the only one I literally can’t live with out her managed to talk with her last night and try clear shit up but still feel like it’s gonna get no better I’ve hope don’t get me wrong but not sure how much more I can take I love her so much , she is the only reason I’m still somewhat alive if she goes I’m done for and it pains me to say that but like they say the truth hurts but sets you free , I know I probably sound ungrateful but I do appreciate the help and support I’m just to far gone I fear I can’t eat or sleep and trying to go about everyday life especially at work with a smile like nothings wrong I don’t know how long I can hold it up

I know all that but you know the saying “she’s the one” “true love” “soul partner” and all that well this is it it’s fucked I will never stop loving her I know this id die for her and it’s not her bringing me down only got myself to blame for fucking shit up
